_comment: Per-repo path buckets consumed by /to-tickets AFK-fit classification (#642, split per #1708). Adding a new repo MUST NOT require editing any SKILL.md — only this file. Paths are gitignore-style globs evaluated against an issue's declared-changed file list. Two buckets per repo: `hitl` = identity/security config, a categorical security boundary — any match is class 3 (afk:3-human), hard refusal. `guarded` = shared surfaces with off-repo consumers — any match is class 2 (afk:2-plan), AFK-eligible once a plan locks. No match in either bucket falls through to Q2-Q4 LLM judgement. For jarvis, hitl mirrors the identity/security subset of docs/security/agent-boundaries.md; guarded covers mcp-memory/** and .mcp.json, whose consumers (redrobot, future jarvis-oss operators) sit outside this repo. For redrobot, the safety-critical zones (driver/, planning/, mujoco/) are guarded, not hitl — redrobot has no hitl entries.
